summary: Assemble the independently corrected local fluid/Maxwell generator and relativistic inertia.

identity.relation: Local effective multi-fluid Maxwell temporal matrix
identity.definition: For k=(kx,0,kz), eps=(epsx,epsy,0): dn_dot=-i(k.v0)dn-n0*(i*k+eps).dv. Momentum A_v*d(v)_dot=-i(k.v0)A_v*dv+(q/m)*(dv cross B0+v0 cross dB+dE)-i*diag(csp2,csp2,csz2)*k*dn/n0+diag(csp2,csp2,csz2)*eps*dn/(gamma*n0)+collision. With D=(Psz-Psp)/B0/rho, add [-i*kz*D*dBx,-i*kz*D*dBy,-2*D*((i*kx+epsx)*dBx+epsy*dBy)] when B0!=0. Maxwell dE_dot=i*c2*(k cross dB)-sum(q*(n0*dv+v0*dn))/epsilon0; dB_dot=-i*(k cross dE). A_v=gamma_rel*I+gamma_rel^3*v0*v0^T/c2 if rel=1. The extra density and magnetic-coefficient gradient terms correct omitted derivatives of the source pressure acceleration. Positive self forcing is replaced by dissipative friction. No Lorentz overwrite correction is claimed: the original Lorentz and anisotropy entries use different columns.
identity.model: Algebraic anisotropic multi-fluid closure with empirical longitudinal magnetic-pressure factor two
identity.coordinates: Species-major [dn,dvx,dvy,dvz], followed by Cartesian E then B
identity.boundary: B0=0 sets director-response terms to zero and retains explicit fixed-z pressure; rel=1 excludes luminal/superluminal drift
assumptions: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia is d(gamma*v)/dv with retained noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Fresh plasma state with explicit primary data and configuration.
inputs.units: mixed physical quantities as declared by state
inputs.constraints: Produced by initialize_pdrf_plasma; primary inputs are revalidated and all derived fields recomputed.

inputs.name: kx
inputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length
inputs.constraints: Complex values describe the local spatial analytic symbol.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

outputs.name: M
outputs.units: row output units per second divided by column state units; normalized analog

outputs.name: A
outputs.units: dimensionless within equally scaled velocity blocks
outputs.constraints: Identity except d(gamma*v)/dv in rel=1 velocity blocks.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Revalidated fresh state used by the matrix.
outputs.constraints: No stale derived fields; preserves explicit collision classes.

outputs.name: scales
outputs.description: Positive physical state-column scales for similarity transformation.
outputs.constraints: Density=n_j, velocity=c, B=sqrt(sum(rho)/epsilon0), E=c*B; transforms rows and columns consistently.

outputs.name: kx
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

outputs.name: kz
outputs.units: m^-1 SI or normalized inverse length

preconditions: State primary data and configuration satisfy the fresh-state contract; derived fields are recomputed.
Finite complex kx/kz; rel is 0 or 1, with strictly subluminal drift for rel=1. Units must be consistent with state.
supported: Corrected local fluid/Maxwell generator, relativistic tangent inertia, algebraic anisotropic pressure response and physical similarity scales. No eigenspectrum, scans or plots are calculated.
excluded: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia is d(gamma*v)/dv with retained noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid state, wave numbers, rel selector, luminal/superluminal rel=1 drift or unrepresentable matrix/scales. State validation failures propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Native numerical conversion or assembly failures propagate.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping returned after failure; no file side effects.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import initialize_pdrf_plasma, assemble_pdrf_matrix
m = assemble_pdrf_matrix(initialize_pdrf_plasma(), .1, .2)
assert m['M'].shape == (14, 14)
example.expected: The default normalized state produced finite M and A matrices of shape (14,14).
